question: Why did Intel's revenue fall in 2023?
summary: Intel's revenue fell in FY2023: $63.05B -> $54.23B (-14.0%). The evidence is consistent with one driver: pricing pressure accompanied lower volumes (gross margin contracted). Only one independent driver was supported, so treat this as a partial explanation.
supported: Pricing pressure accompanied lower volumes (gross margin contracted)
Operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue)

H1: Pricing pressure accompanied lower volumes (gross margin contracted)
H2: Inventory piled up as demand fell (demand-led decline)
H3: Operating leverage amplified the move (operating income moved more than revenue)

reference: Revenue fell 14% on weaker PC and server demand (customer inventory digestion) across CCG and DCAI (Intel 2023 10-K).
